Solopreneur Guide 1.0.0

- Initial release: Complete, structured guide for building and operating an AI-driven one-person business.
- Covers core concepts, workflows (content, product, marketing, finance, customer service), and must-have tools.
- Includes AI/automation use-cases, step-by-step startup checklists, standard SOP templates, and practical trigger scenarios.
- Designed to help solopreneurs quickly launch, scale, and standardize their business for maximum efficiency and minimal risk.
